author: UncondemnedSinner
body:
Shrines, coins and EXP gear.... And then get out of the house and hunt bosses in the wild.  No fooling, I managed 110 BILLION Exp this week.... Simply by following this pattern.

Gear, for me, 2 band of gods, Arisen Deathbringer (godforged), Lost Helmet (Godforged), Court Jester's gear (demonforged) and whatever boots will give me good DEF.

Not only did I pull 110 billion EXP, I also managed 53 Million Orn from the run.  (For the record, I am now 28 billion EXP from level 249..... 250, here I come.)

Seriously, forget dungeons, they only give you 25% of what you can get if you get on a bus and play while it drives you around.

body: So! I recently swapped from arcanic to summoner and was level 180ish. I ended up using around 30 summon scrolls and some kingdom raids (along with random bosses and such) and got to level 200 in about 4 days. I guess it depends on your class really!

author: Smooth-Drink-3753
body: I usually stack minimum 200 arena tokens. Then pop a dousing rod, exp potion, lucky coin, lucky silver coin, and whatever shrines I can. Go through all tokens and with whatever time remains fire up an affinity candle and scroll of chaos. I can usually level a couple times each with this method and am currently sitting at 165
